تستقطبون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِبُونَ (tastaqṭibūna) /tas.taq.tˤi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# تُسْتَقْطَبُونَ (tustaqṭabūna) /tus.taq.tˤa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
